field_meanings.price_sale_ars: Current promo price (what the card highlights).
field_meanings.cuota_24_ars: Monthly installment if financed in 24 interest-free BNA+ MODO dues.
field_meanings.is_ac: True for Split/Ventana/Portatil/Piso-techo/Cassette. False for fans, heaters, accessories.
field_meanings.frigorias_estimated_from_watts: True when fg was not in the title and was approximated as watts*0.86.

notes_for_analysis: The catalog mixes ACs with fans, heaters, evaporative climatizers and a few unrelated accessories.
Some SKUs appear more than once with different prices; treat them as distinct listings.
Watts and frigorias are parsed from the product title and can be missing or wrong.
Prices change; this dump is a snapshot from 2026-09-11.
Use is_ac=true when comparing air conditioners.
